answer_1.quote: In this paper, we design a framework for generating diverse descriptions. ... we first use the OFA model to generate synthetic descriptions consistent with image content ... we introduce an open‑set image tagging model RAM++ to capture more detailed and precise semantic information from images. By leveraging LLMs, we synthesize and refine information from web‑based texts, synthetic captions, and detection tags.
answer_1.outputs: synthetic captions, detection tags, generated diverse descriptions

answer_2.quote: Our analysis of cosine similarity (computed by CLIP‑L14) and token counts across different text types reveals that synthetic captions and generated diverse descriptions have higher average similarity and token counts than raw texts.
